absent: Full definitions of folio, lruvec, scan_control, pgdat, zone, and mem_cgroup beyond fields observed here.
Locking beyond cost lock, including folio chain, zone, and node protections.
Internals of promotion, generation increment, tier mapping, sequence conversion, and type selection helpers.
Proportional protection, continuation, watermark, throttling, pressure, and hopelessness mechanisms.
Tracepoint payloads and VM event accounting semantics.
Plug, walk, priority initialization, and single versus many group shrink paths.
Exact numeric values of batch, generation, zone, tier, priority, and swappiness constants.

findings.text: Oldest generation scan walks zones in rotation derived from reclaim ceiling, considers each resident folio once per pass, first offers it to protection logic then to isolation logic, parks contended entries aside for reattachment, and halts when intake quota is consumed or when isolated or deferred batches reach floor thresholds, finally folding tallies into per-group counters and trace reporting.

Scanning assumes destination starts empty and requested intake stays within batch ceiling, proceeds only when more than minimal generation count exists, and expects each visited entry to be evictable-candidate, inactive, of requested file versus anon kind, and resident in visited zone.

Per-folio triage distinguishes freshly promoted entries by generation mismatch, over-threshold or saturated reference histories, and zone ineligibility above reclaim ceiling, relocating each such case within generation structures and accounting protected volume except for lazily promoted workingset, while remaining evictable candidates are returned for isolation and unevictable ones are passed through to generic handling.

Isolation requires obtaining an extra folio reference and clearing membership flag atomically, resets reference history when no recent reference exists, and expects removal from generation accounting to succeed, treating failures of the first two steps as contention to be retried later.

Protection threshold search anchors a setpoint at lowest tier with modest gain and compares successive tiers with higher gain, stopping before first tier that does not show positive control error; type choice pins file at minimal swappiness and anon at maximal swappiness, otherwise compares whole-range anon versus file positions with complementary swappiness-derived gains.

Controller position aggregates averaged plus current-history refaulted volume and total volume including protected and evicted contributions across requested tier window, carrying supplied gain for later ratio comparison.
Positive error is reported when process value shows fewer refaults than batch floor or when gain-weighted fault ratios favor process over setpoint after small bias adjustments for stability.

Aging is mandatory when evictable minimum plus minimal generation window exceeds observed maximum, suppressed at default priority to favor gentle reclaim, and otherwise triggered exactly at window edge; evictable minimum is lesser of two type-indexed minima selected by swappiness extremes.

Scan intake honors proactive anon-only mode with misuse warning and early skip when anon unreclaimable, reclaims full evictable volume for offline groups, and otherwise applies proportional protection then scales down exponentially with priority.
Evictable volume sums clamped non-negative page counts across all zones and all generations between per-type minima and global maximum, restricted to types deemed evictable under current swappiness.

Scan abort triggers on pending signal during proactive work or when reclaimed volume meets requested or compaction-gap target; background reclaimer at zero order additionally succeeds only when every eligible managed zone satisfies tiering-aware high or promotion watermark plus batch headroom, otherwise it continues.
One generation shrink vector variant is a build-time failure placeholder, so selecting it prevents kernel construction rather than providing runtime behavior.

Node reclaim prefers generation path for root context when enabled and stable, otherwise resets per-cycle tallies, prepares balance state, reclaims through member groups, folds externally freed pages, records pressure except for proactive work, flags writeback or congestion when taken pages show those patterns, applies throttling for background versus direct contexts, and repeats while continuation predicate holds, clearing hopelessness on progress.

Externally freed slab, pruned file, and filesystem buffer pages staged in current reclaim state are folded into reclaimed tally only for root reclaim, then staging is cleared to avoid double counting or under-reclaim from targeted groups.
Throttling permission is denied only when current thread carries local throttle exemption flag.

Balance preparation serializes sampling and update of anon and file cost entries under target vector cost lock, deriving deltas from monotonic rotation and IO counters with extra write volume on anon side, weighting IO by cluster size, decaying both counts while their sum exceeds quarter of combined LRU size, then publishing results to control.

When generation mode is stable preparation returns immediately; otherwise it derives per-type deactivation hints from refault changes or low inactive levels unless forced, enables cache trim when abundant inactive file exists without deactivation pressure and trimming allowed, and marks file tiny for global reclaim when file plus free stays within high watermark headroom while anon pressure remains.

Reclaim control observed here carries reclaim_idx plus order plus priority plus nr_reclaimed plus nr_to_reclaim plus proactive plus hibernation_mode plus may_writepage plus may_unmap plus gfp_mask plus target_mem_cgroup plus force_deactivate plus may_deactivate plus no_cache_trim_mode plus cache_trim_mode plus cache_trim_mode_failed plus file_is_tiny plus anon_cost plus file_cost plus nested nr with taken plus writeback plus immediate plus dirty plus congested.

Vector observed here carries lrugen plus cost plus cost_lock plus refaults plus flags; generation store carries min_seq plus folios plus nr_pages plus protected plus avg_refaulted plus avg_total plus refaulted plus evicted; folio linkage uses lru; zone and node linkage uses node_zones plus pgdat.
Position carries gain plus refaulted plus total; cost carries count plus last_rotated plus last_io.
Provides monotonic unsigned view of per-group statistic with fallback to node counter when grouping disabled and guarded zero on unknown index.
Provides monotonic unsigned view of node counter via atomic long read.
Flushes group statistics only when current time exceeds last flush by two flush intervals.
Sums a zone statistic across all zones of a node.

Generation node shrink drains pending additions, establishes plug and walk plus initial priority, preserves background reclaimer tally across single-group versus many-group shrink, then tears down walk and plug and clears hopelessness when forward progress occurred, skipping entirely when writepage or unmap is disallowed.

Isolation contends with concurrent release and isolation via reference acquisition and flag clearing; cost deltas use monotonic unsigned sampling to survive counter wraparound that clamped readers would misread; proactive scans must observe pending signals; background reclaim stalls on writeback cycling or congestion rather than busy looping.

Constants MIN_LRU_BATCH plus MAX_LRU_BATCH bound batches, MIN_NR_GENS bounds generations, MAX_NR_ZONES plus MAX_NR_TIERS bound dimensions, DEF_PRIORITY marks default, MIN_SWAPPINESS plus MAX_SWAPPINESS plus SWAPPINESS_ANON_ONLY tune anon balance, LRU_GEN_FILE plus LRU_GEN_ANON select type, PGSCAN_KSWAPD plus PGSCAN_SKIP plus PGREFILL plus related tags account scans, WMARK_PROMO plus WMARK_HIGH select watermarks, PGDAT_WRITEBACK plus LRUVEC flags plus VMSCAN_THROTTLE selections signal pressure, PF_LOCAL_THROTTLE marks exemption.
